title: Zoho Recruit integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Zoho Recruit
Zoho Recruit is a cloud-based applicant tracking system built to support end-to-end recruitment operations. It helps organizations manage job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview coordination, and hiring workflows from a centralized, easy-to-use platform.
Why Integrate Zoho Recruit with Xobin?
Integrating Zoho Recruit with Xobin allows hiring teams to seamlessly combine applicant tracking with AI-powered skill assessments. Recruiters can trigger role-specific assessments directly from Zoho Recruit and automatically sync results back into the ATS. This eliminates manual follow-ups, reduces screening time, and ensures objective candidate evaluation based on real skills rather than resumes alone.
Steps to Integrate Zoho Recruit with Xobin
Set up the Zoho Recruit and Xobin integration in a few simple steps to streamline your hiring process.
1. Setting Up the Integration in Xobin
Log in to your Xobin Dashboard.
From the left-hand navigation menu, click
Settings
On the Settings page, navigate to the
Integrations
tab at the top-right corner.
Locate the
Zoho Recruit
integration.
Click the dropdown and select
Generate API Key
You will be redirected to Zoho Recruit to authorize the connection.
Click
Accept
to grant Xobin permission to connect with Zoho Recruit.
After authorization, you will be redirected back to Xobin, where the API Key and Xobin Domain Name will be generated.
At this point, the integration setup on the Xobin side is complete.
2. Setting Up the Integration in Zoho Recruit
Log in to your Zoho Recruit account.
Navigate to the
Setup
menu.
Under Setup, click
Marketplace
Search for
Xobin Assessments for Zoho Recruit
Select the extension from the search results.
Accept the Terms of Service and click
Install
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete installation, including selecting the relevant users or profiles.
Once installation is complete, an
Extension Settings
modal will appear.
Enter the
Xobin Domain Name
copied from the Xobin Settings page.
Save
to finalize the configuration.
The integration between Xobin and Zoho Recruit is now successfully completed. Recruiters can proceed to send assessment invitations to candidates directly from Zoho Recruit.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruiters, HR managers, and talent acquisition teams using Zoho Recruit who want to add structured, skill-based assessments to their hiring process. It is well-suited for startups, mid-sized companies, enterprises, and staffing agencies hiring for technical, functional, and cognitive roles where accurate skill evaluation is critical.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Assessments inside your ATS
Trigger role-specific Xobin assessments for any candidate directly from the Zoho Recruit record, without switching tools.
Marketplace extension setup
Install "Xobin Assessments for Zoho Recruit" from the Zoho Marketplace and connect it with a single API key and domain name.
Automatic result sync
Assessment outcomes flow back into Zoho Recruit so recruiters can review scores alongside the rest of the candidate profile.
Live candidate progress tracking
See who has been invited, who is in progress and who has completed their assessment without manual follow-ups.
Objective, skill-first screening
Evaluate candidates on demonstrated skills rather than resumes alone, keeping shortlisting consistent across the hiring team.
Built for every hiring team
Suited to startups, mid-sized companies, enterprises and staffing agencies hiring for technical, functional and cognitive roles.
Answers
Frequently asked questions
